cohort: 2203 singleton very-low-birth-weight infants (VLBWI) with a birth weight <1500g and gestational age between 22 0/7 and 36 6/7 weeks born and discharged between 1st of January 2009 and 31st of December 2015
finding: Elective cesarean section is associated with a reduced risk of IVH in preterm infants <30 weeks gestational age when presenting with preterm labor.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery and emergency cesarean section were independently associated with IVH risk in preterm infants <30 weeks gestational age, while in infants >30 weeks gestation there was no difference in IVH risk between planned cesarean and vaginal delivery.
